newsitem.title: USA: MOODY'S MAY UP EQUITABLE OF IOWA COS RATINGS.
newsitem.headline: MOODY'S MAY UP EQUITABLE OF IOWA COS RATINGS.

text.p: NEW YORK, July 9 - Moody's Investors Service placed the debt ratings of Equitable of Iowa Companies (EIC) (senior at A3) on review for possible upgrade. The rating agency also placed the A1 insurance financial strength ratings of Equitable Life Insurance Company of Iowa and USG Annuity and Life Company -- EIC's wholly owned life insurance subsidiaries -- on review for possible upgrade.

These rating actions follow EIC's recent announcement that its Board of Directors had approved a definitive merger agreement under which the company would become a wholly owned subsidiary of the ING Groep, N.V. of the Netherlands (ING). The merger is subject to regulatory, shareholder, and other approvals.

Moody's noted that its review would focus on the market position, earnings potential, merger-related cost savings, and capital structure of EIC's life insurance operations within the ING organization.

EIC maintains an established position in the individual annuity market through its efficient operations, multiple-channel distribution network, and good profitability. The rating agency also noted that the level of ING Groep's support for EIC would be an additional factor in its rating decision.
The senior debt of Internationale Nederlanden Verzekeringen N.V. -- the Dutch insurance parent company -- is currently rated Aa2.

Ratings on review for possible upgrade are as follows: Equitable of Iowa Companies: senior debt at A3; junior subordinated debt at Baa1; the rating of the company for commercial paper at Prime-2; provisional senior debt shelf and warrants at (P)A3; provisional senior subordinated debt shelf and warrants at (P)Baa1; provisional junior subordinated debt shelf at (P)Baa1; provisional senior cumulative preferred stock shelf at (P)"a3"; provisional senior non-cumulative, junior cumulative and junior non-cumulative preferred stock shelf and warrants at (P)"baa1";

Equitable of Iowa Capital Trust: preferred stock rating of "a3"; Equitable of Iowa Companies Capital Trust II: preferred stock rating of "a3"; Equitable Life Insurance Company of Iowa: insurance financial strength ratings at A1; USG Annuity and Life Company: insurance financial strength ratings at A1.

Equitable of Iowa Companies is an insurance holding company that is located in Des Moines, Iowa. At December 31, 1996, consolidated GAAP assets and consolidated GAAP stockholders' equity stood at $12.7 billion and $824 million, respectively. Wednesday, 9 July 1997 19:50:41 ENDS nN09151700
